newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech offers int'l wholesale service.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech offers int'l wholesale service.

text.p: Ameritech said Thursday it is entering the long-distance international wholesale business, offering switching and transport capabilities to long-distance, wireless and local phone companies and Internet service providers.

Ameritech has formed a subsidiary, Global Gateway Services, to handle the new service. The subsidiary will provide the international service to the company's cellular phone division and eventually to its long-distance unit, once the Baby Bell is approved to enter the long-distance market in its five-state region.

Ameritech said the international long distance market is one of the fastest growing areas of the communications industry, with the market expected to grow to about $75 billion by the year 2000. The current market is estimated at about $60 billion, the company said.
Ameritech will itself lease much of the necessary networks, and offer the lines, switches, customer service, billing and other additional services to its clients.
Ameritech said it will take advantage of its current relationships with phone companies in Belgium, Hungary, Norway and New Zealand.
